events.text: [26 June 2024] The President has signed the Finance Bill 2024 into law in the form first published, including 16% VAT on bread, a 2.5% annual motor vehicle tax, an eco levy, VAT on some financial services and higher excise on mobile money fees. The new measures take effect on 1 July.

[1 July 2024] The Finance Act 2024 takes effect today. A 400g loaf of bread now costs about Sh10 more with 16% VAT, mobile money and bank fees rise, and the eco levy applies to diapers, sanitary pads and packaging.
